claims: Zuffa Boxing was launched in June 2025.
Zuffa Boxing was launched by TKO Group Holdings and Dana White.
Zuffa Boxing was launched in partnership with Saudi Arabia's Sela.
Zuffa Boxing is a boxing promotion.
Zuffa Boxing is part of the Zuffa brand.
Zuffa Boxing features its own championship belts.
Zuffa Boxing has secured broadcasting deals with Paramount+ in the U.S.
Zuffa Boxing has secured broadcasting deals with Sky Sports in the UK.
Conor Benn signed a multi-year, multi-fight deal with Zuffa Boxing.
Jai Opetaia signed a multi-year, multi-fight deal with Zuffa Boxing.
Jai Opetaia is the IBF cruiserweight champion.
Callum Walsh signed a multi-year, multi-fight deal with Zuffa Boxing.
Jose Valenzuela signed a multi-year, multi-fight deal with Zuffa Boxing.
Edgar Berlanga signed a multi-year, multi-fight deal with Zuffa Boxing.
Vito Mielnicki signed a multi-year, multi-fight deal with Zuffa Boxing.
Zuffa Boxing held its inaugural fights early in 2026.
Zuffa Boxing has staged events at London's Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.
Zuffa Boxing operates with its own ranking system.
Zuffa Boxing's ranking system often uses Ring Magazine's structure.
Zuffa Boxing disregards some traditional sanctioning bodies.
Zuffa, LLC is a subsidiary of TKO Group Holdings.
Zuffa, LLC is the legal entity behind Zuffa Boxing.
The Zuffa Boxing roster is reported to have over 100 fighters.
